biotools.summary: Causeway is a Nextflow pipeline designed for Mendelian Randomization and colocalization analysis to identify candidate causal genes by integrating quantitative trait loci and disease genome-wide association studies.  It’s designed to be computationally efficient and scalable to different computing environments.
